title: Eternal Shadow
next_chapter_hook: The shadow of Chen Ji slowly raised his head, and in the instant their eyes met, the causal karma of ten thousand ages collided violently—at the moment the five words 'You have finally come' fell, Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value trembled violently.

text.content: The call from the depths of the Source of Destiny was like an invisible thread, tightly wrapping around Chen Ji's spirit. The voice was unmistakably his own, yet carried an inexplicable sense of strangeness, like an echo from another dimension.

He did not hesitate. Or rather, the moment he stepped into the Source of Destiny, he knew there was no turning back. Beneath his feet was endless void, above was an invisible heaven, yet only that call served as a beacon guiding the way.

dialogue.content: 「Since it's my voice calling me... let me go see what this 'self' wants to tell me.」

text.content: As he ventured deeper, the surroundings began to transform. The chaotic void gradually coalesced into a vast, boundless river—not flowing with water, but with countless fragments of light—shards of time, remnants of fate.

Chen Ji stopped his footsteps, gazing at that river. The Tianji Record Fragment within him grew warm, as if sensing something. He knew this was the core of the Source of Destiny—the embodiment of the River of Time. For ten thousand years, countless cultivators had attempted to窥探 its mysteries, only to be annihilated within this endless flow of time.
And he was going to walk into it.

The moment he stepped into the river, a torrent of overwhelming information flooded into Chen Ji's mind. Images from ten thousand years ago flashed by like a kaleidoscope, each frame terrifyingly clear, each frame tearing apart his understanding. He saw the predecessor of the Tianqing Sect, the embryonic form before the three great sects split, countless familiar yet foreign faces...
Then, he saw a figure.

In the very center of the river, a figure stood proudly alone. The person wore simple cyan robes, his features identical to Chen Ji's—even the hidden edge in his brow was precisely the same. He stood there beneath the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, surrounded by countless threads of karma, like a puppet controlled by fate.

Heavenly Eye. Chen Ji had never seen it before, yet the moment he glimpsed it, he recognized its identity. It was a colossal eye spanning across the heavens, its depths containing the destruction and rebirth of countless stars, each blink representing the end of a heavenly cycle.

And that figure, identical to him, was slowly raising a book scroll in his hands beneath the Heavenly Eye's gaze. The scroll emanated brilliant light, and even though it was merely a phantom from a shadow, Chen Ji could sense the terrifying power contained within—it was the Tianji Record, yet entirely different from the fragment he possessed.

「That is... the complete version of the Tianji Record?」Chen Ji's spirit shook violently. Mo Xiansheng had said that the Tianji Record was divided into countless fragments scattered across the world, each page containing a portion of heavenly secrets. And what now appeared before his eyes was clearly the legendary complete prototype.

The images continued to flow. That figure raised the complete Tianji Record above his head, his lips seeming to recite something. The Heavenly Eye slowly blinked, and billions of law chains emerged from the void, wrapping around that figure layer upon layer. Chen Ji saw blood—his own blood—gushing from his seven apertures, dyeing the entire Tianji Record red.

Sacrifice. That was sacrifice. The figure from ten thousand years ago was using himself as the offering to awaken some power within the Tianji Record. And the Heavenly Eye was the mastermind behind this sacrifice.

choice.prompt: The scene before him made Chen Ji's spirit tremble violently—that sacrificial figure from ten thousand years ago was clearly himself. At this moment, he had to make a choice—

choices.description: Continue deeper into the River of Time, tracing more fragments of truth from ten thousand years ago, even if it means potentially losing oneself in the karma.
choices.risk_hint: May fall into time loops or suffer karma backlash

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth and walked toward that figure. With each step closer, the temporal turbulence around him grew more violent, as if wanting to tear him apart. But he could not retreat, nor could he retreat. The truth from ten thousand years ago lay hidden in the depths of this river of time.

As he drew closer, more and more images flooded into his mind. He saw the true origin of the Tianji Record—it was not created by some ancient immortal, but a tool gradually condensed by the Heavenly Eye over endless years. Every prophet was merely its chess piece.

choices.description: Exit the River of Time, first digest the information already seen, seek more clues about the Tianji Record before deciding.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, find another breakthrough point
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be forever sealed

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to stop. He knew many people would lose their minds upon seeing the truth, desperately trying to uncover more. But he was Chen Ji, that calculatingtrash disciple who never made a move without certainty. He chose to step back, first firmly memorizing these images.

「Ten thousand years ago, I was sacrificed... the Heavenly Eye is the mastermind... the Tianji Record is its tool...」Chen Ji organized this information one by one, storing it in the deepest part of his heart. These truths were too horrifying; he needed more time to analyze their meaning.

However, whether choosing to face or avoid, fate seemed to have already determined the direction. The moment Chen Ji was deep in thought, a voice came from the depths of the River of Time—his own voice, yet carrying a transcendantly weathered quality.

dialogue.content: 「Do you think you have the right to choose? Chen Xuan from ten thousand years ago thought the same, and Chen Ji from ten thousand years ago thought the same. And now, you—merely another chess piece.」

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind—it was not sound transmitted through eardrums, but a direct意志压迫 upon his soul. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining madly, as if some invisible force was dragging him into the abyss.

dialogue.content: 「Chess piece?」Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned ice-cold, even a hint of mockery curling at the corner of his lips, 「If I were truly a chess piece, why bother manipulating me? Wouldn't it be simpler to wipe me out directly?」

text.content: The Heavenly Eye fell silent. That colossal eye spanning the heavens slightly narrowed, and deep within its depths, fury seemed to be burning. For ten thousand years, no one had dared speak to it this way. Even those ancient great powers could only bow in submission before it. Yet this ant-like junior dared to speak provocatively.

「Ant?」Chen Ji seemed to hear its mockery, his cold smile deepening, 「The me from ten thousand years ago was also called an ant by you, wasn't he? But he dared to sacrifice himself, dared to expose your conspiracy. And you? Besides high-handedly surveying all beings, what else can you do?」

The River of Time violently shook. Countless fragments of images flew around Chen Ji, revealing more fragments of truth—the Chen Xuan from ten thousand years ago did not die by accident, but was eliminated by the Heavenly Eye through someone else's hands; the fragments of the Tianji Record scattered across the world, each page bearing its plan to collect the fates of all beings; and the so-called Heavenly Fate Value was merely a measurement unit for gauging the consumption of chess pieces.

choice.prompt: Truth crashed in like a tide, almost bursting Chen Ji's spirit. Yet just then, an even more shocking image emerged—those were a pair of eyes identical to his own, piercing through the barrier of the River of Time, gazing directly at him.

choices.description: The Chen Ji from ten thousand years ago was looking at him, and that gaze held no resentment, only a profound expectation. He chose to respond to this expectation.
choices.visible_reward: Establish connection with past life, may obtain key inheritance
choices.risk_hint: May cause personality confusion or be devoured by past life memories

text.content: Chen Ji did not evade those eyes. He advanced toward them, locking gazes with his self from ten thousand years ago. In that instant, he saw Chen Xuan's entire lifetime of memories—those schemes, those sacrifices, those resolute decisions to move forward despite knowing death was certain.
「You have finally come.」The shadow of Chen Xuan spoke, his voice aged yet gentle, 「I have waited for this day, for ten thousand years.」

choices.description: This is too bizarre, he does not believe anything is worth waiting ten thousand years for. He chooses to forcibly sever the connection with the shadow, preserving himself.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent judgment,不被 past life influence
choices.risk_hint: May miss important information or provoke Heavenly Eye attack

text.content: 「Wait ten thousand years?」Chen Ji abruptly closed his eyes, mobilizing all the power within his body to construct a barrier in his spirit, 「I don't believe there's anything in this world worth waiting ten thousand years for. If you truly are my past life, you shouldn't meet me this way.」

The barrier exploded violently, isolating that shadow outside. However, in the final moment before the connection broke, Chen Ji heard the shadow's sigh—「You are still too weak. When you are strong enough, come find me again. Remember, the truth of the Tianji Record... lies on the fifth page...」

No matter what choice was made, the scene before them began to dissolve. The images from ten thousand years ago shattered like dreams and bubbles, the Heavenly Eye's colossal eye slowly retreated into the void, and that figure identical to him gradually faded away.

But just before completely disappearing, the shadow of Chen Xuan—or rather, the other Chen Ji—suddenly raised his head. His movements were extremely slow, yet seemed to traverse ten thousand years of time, directly locking gazes with the present Chen Ji.

Four words fell, and Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value suddenly tremble. Not draining, but some kind of resonance—as if something long dormant was awakening within these two calls spanning ten thousand years.

The River of Time gradually calmed, and Chen Ji found himself back at the edge of the Source of Destiny. The Tianji Record Fragment in his hand emanated a warm glow, seemingly now bearing some patterns it did not have before—were these things left for him by the Chen Xuan from ten thousand years ago, or another trap set by the Heavenly Eye?
He lowered his gaze to the fragment, only to see on the originally blank back, faint characters now appearing: 「The fifth page lies hidden in the Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds.」

Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds. A place Chen Ji had never set foot in, a place the former Sect Master Ling Yuan strictly prohibited anyone from approaching. He had investigated secretly multiple times but never found the entrance. And now, his self from ten thousand years ago had given him an answer.

dialogue.content: 「Interesting.」Chen Ji tucked the fragment into his chest, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips, 「Chen Xuan from ten thousand years ago... no, I should say, my self from ten thousand years ago, pointed a way for me. And this path happens to be within the Tianqing Sect.」

text.content: He raised his head, gazing toward the void in the depths of the Source of Destiny. The Heavenly Eye was no longer visible, but Chen Ji knew that terrifying existence had never truly left. It was waiting, observing, gradually leading him into a chess game already set up long ago.

dialogue.content: 「Want to make me a chess piece?」Chen Ji said softly, his voice terrifyingly calm, 「Then let's see, in the end, who devours whom.」

text.content: The moment he left the Source of Destiny, Chen Ji felt subtle changes in the heavenly rules around him. He knew the gains this time far exceeded expectations—the truth from ten thousand years ago, clues to the fifth page of the Tianji Record, and the Heavenly Eye's true purpose. This information was enough for him to recalculate the entire chess game.

However, at the same time, an even more terrifying thought arose in his heart: since the Chen Xuan from ten thousand years ago could sacrifice himself to overturn the Heavenly Eye's control, why did he fail? Where exactly did his plan go wrong? And would that problem also appear on himself?

Night deepened, and Chen Ji stood alone on the mountain peak outside the Source of Destiny. Moonlight fell upon him, stretching his shadow long. That shadow overlapped with the figure in the shadow from ten thousand years ago, as if the Chen Ji's of two eras had completed some kind of cross-temporal交接 at this moment.

dialogue.content: 「Fifth page... Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds...」Chen Ji murmured to himself, his eyes flickering with complex light, 「Ling Yuan, what role do you actually play in this chess game?」

text.content: He still had much to do. The fifth page of the Tianji Record must be obtained, the secrets of the Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds must be uncovered, and the true face of Former Sect Master Ling Yuan must be investigated quickly. But before that, he needed to handle one thing first—that woman who had always been by his side, intelligent enough to make even him wary.

dialogue.content: 「Su Qingyao...」Chen Ji softly uttered this name, a bitter smile appearing at the corner of his lips, 「With her sharpness, she's probably already noticed something.」

text.content: The night wind blew past, bringing a hint of chill. Chen Ji took one last look toward the Source of Destiny, then turned and flew toward the Tianqing Sect. The eternal mystery had raised its curtain, and he stood right at the center of this chess game. No matter what awaited ahead, he would not retreat.

After all, he was Chen Ji. That Chen Ji who calculated everything perfectly, who never fought a battle without certainty. The Heavenly Eye wanted to make him a chess piece? Then let's see, in the end, who devours whom!
